İbrâhîm ile Ömer Ramazan’ı ve bayramı ne: Where will Ibrāhīm and ʿUmar spend Ramadan and the festival?
Saîd umre için memleketinden ayrıldı ve: Saʿīd left his homeland for ʿumra and reached the mīqāt in the morning. He put on the iḥrām, recited the talbiya for ʿumra, then went to Makkah the Honoured. Saʿīd arrived in Makkah after the afternoon prayer. In the Sacred Mosque he felt happiness; he circumambulated the Kaʿba seven rounds, then walked between Ṣafā and Marwa and shaved his head.
Ahmed Kâbe’nin etrafında yedi şavt tavaf: Aḥmad circumambulated the Kaʿba seven rounds, prayed two rakʿas behind the Station of Ibrāhīm, then walked seven rounds between Ṣafā and Marwa, then shaved his head, went to the hotel and took off the iḥrām. After ʿumra he returned to his homeland. A year later, God willing, he will come with his family for Hajj and ʿumra.
Sâlih Ramazan tatilini Mekke ve Medine’d: Ṣāliḥ is spending the Ramadan vacation in Makkah and Madinah. In Makkah he stays in a hotel near the Sacred Mosque. With his family he goes to the mosque before the afternoon prayer and prays the sunset and night prayers. He breaks his fast in the mosque and does not eat much: he takes dates, water and coffee. In Madinah he stays in an apartment far from the Prophet’s Mosque; with his family he goes to the Prophet’s Mosque before the sunset prayer, stays until the night prayer, prays it, then returns to the apartment by bus. He spends the first day of the festival in Madinah and the second day in Makkah.

He is happy in Makkah; he lives in a nice apartment near the Sacred Mosque. His family came from Thailand to Makkah for Hajj; after Hajj they went to Madinah the Illuminated and stayed in a hotel near the Prophet’s Mosque. They prayed the five daily prayers in the Prophet’s Mosque; after the night prayer they went to the market and ate and drank a little. After three days they returned to Makkah and spent a week with Maḥmūd in his apartment. Then they went to Jeddah — what a beautiful and big city! They spent a happy time in Jeddah. On the day of travel they went to the airport and from there flew back to Thailand.

İslam’da kaç bayram var, babacığım?: How many festivals are there in Islam, Father?
İslam’da iki bayram var: Ramazan bayramı: There are two festivals in Islam: the festival of Ramadan (ʿĪd al-Fiṭr) and the festival of the Sacrifice (ʿĪd al-Aḍḥā).
Ramazan bayramı ne zaman olur?: When is the festival of Ramadan?
Ramazan ayından sonra: Şevval’in ilk gün: After the month of Ramadan: the first day of Shawwāl.
Bayram günü ne yaparız?: What do we do on the festival day?
We give the zakat al-fiṭr to the poor.
One ṣāʿ of food for each person.
Ondan sonra ne yaparız?: What do we do after that?
Bayram namazını kılarız; akrabaları ve a: We pray the festival prayer; we visit relatives and friends.
Kurban bayramı ne zaman olur?: When is the festival of the Sacrifice?
The tenth day of Dhū l-Ḥijja.
Kurban bayramında ne yaparız?: What do we do on the festival of the Sacrifice?
Bayram namazını kılarız, kurbanı keseriz: We pray the festival prayer, slaughter the sacrifice, and visit relatives and friends.

في الإِسْلامِ عيدانِ: عيدُ الفِطْرِ، وَعيدُ الأَضْحى. يَكونُ عيدُ الفِطْرِ بَعْدَ شَهْرِ رَمَضانَ؛ في اليَوْمِ الأَوَّلِ مِنْ شَهْرِ شَوّالٍ. بَعْدَ الصَّوْمِ نُؤَدّي زَكاةَ الفِطْرِ لِلْفُقَراءِ قَبْلَ صَلاةِ العيدِ، وَهِيَ صاعٌ مِنْ طَعامٍ عَنْ كُلِّ شَخْصٍ كَبيرٍ وَصَغيرٍ. وَبَعْدَ صَلاةِ العيدِ نَزورُ الأَهْلَ وَالأَصْدِقاءَ.
يَأْتي عيدُ الأَضْحى بَعْدَ الوُقوفِ بِعَرَفَةَ. نُصَلّي صَلاةَ العيدِ بَعْدَ شُروقِ الشَّمْسِ، وَنَذْبَحُ الأُضْحِيَةَ، وَنَزورُ الأَهْلَ وَالأَصْدِقاءَ. بَعْضُ النّاسِ يَقْضي عُطْلَةَ العيدِ في المَدينَةِ، أَوْ في القَرْيَةِ، أَوْ عَلى شاطِئِ البَحْرِ.
İslam’da iki bayram vardır: Ramazan bayr: There are two festivals in Islam: ʿĪd al-Fiṭr (the festival of Ramadan) and ʿĪd al-Aḍḥā (the festival of the Sacrifice). ʿĪd al-Fiṭr comes after the month of Ramadan, on the first day of Shawwāl. After fasting, before the festival prayer, we give the zakat al-fiṭr to the poor; it is one ṣāʿ of food for each person, big and small. After the festival prayer we visit relatives and friends. ʿĪd al-Aḍḥā comes after the standing at ʿArafa. We pray the festival prayer after sunrise, slaughter the sacrifice, and visit relatives and friends. Some people spend the festival vacation in the city, in the village, or at the seaside.

وَعَلِيٌّ سَيُسافِرُ إِلى السُّعودِيَّةِ؛ لِيَقْضِيَ العُطْلَةَ بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَالمَدينَةِ، وَسَيَعْتَمِرُ وَيَبْقى شَهْرًا في مَكَّةَ بِالقُرْبِ مِنَ المَسْجِدِ الحَرامِ، وَسَيَبْقى شَهْرًا في المَدينَةِ بِالقُرْبِ مِنَ المَسْجِدِ النَّبَوِيِّ.
